text: Tarski's decidability result rests on the fact that the theory of real-closed fields admits ___ elimination: every formula is provably equivalent to a quantifier-free Boolean combination of polynomial (in)equalities.
explanation: Quantifier elimination reduces every RCF formula to a quantifier-free combination of polynomial equalities and inequalities, which for a sentence is decided outright — giving both completeness and decidability, inherited by geometry through bi-interpretation.
